<member name="P:Inno.Core.Identity.Identity.persistentId">
    <summary>
    Gets the stable identifier preserved by serialization and runtime reconstruction.
    </summary>
</member>

<member name="P:Inno.Core.Identity.Identity.runtimeId">
    <summary>
    Gets the identifier assigned by the currently bound runtime registry.
    </summary>
    <remarks>
    The value is <see langword="null"/> while this identity is not bound to a live registry.
    </remarks>
</member>

<member name="P:Inno.Core.Identity.Identity.runtimeIdentity">
    <summary>
    Gets the domain-qualified runtime identity while this object is registered.
    </summary>
    <remarks>
    The value is <see langword="null"/> when this identity is detached or its registry is no longer reachable.
    </remarks>
</member>

    </param>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Core.Identity.Identity.Resolve``1">
    <summary>
    Resolves this transient snapshot through its original weak identity registry.
    </summary>
    <typeparam name="TObject">
    The expected identity object type.
    </typeparam>
    <returns>
    The current object, or null if the registry retired, the slot changed generation, or the type differs.
    </returns>
</member>

<member name="T:Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityAllocator">
    <summary>
    Owns the persistent-to-runtime identity map for one isolated runtime session.
    </summary>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityAllocator.#ctor">
    <summary>
    Creates an isolated runtime identity domain.
    </summary>
    <exception cref="T:System.InvalidOperationException">
    Thrown if the process exhausts the available identity-domain values.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="P:Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityAllocator.hasCurrent">
    <summary>
    Gets whether the current asynchronous execution context is bound to an allocator.
    </summary>
</member>

<member name="P:Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityAllocator.current">
    <summary>
    Gets the allocator bound to the current asynchronous execution context.
    </summary>
    <exception cref="T:System.InvalidOperationException">
    Thrown when the caller is outside a runtime session execution scope.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="P:Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityAllocator.count">
    <summary>
    Gets the number of currently registered identity entries.
    </summary>
    <remarks>
    Registry entries are weak. An entry whose object has been collected may remain counted until a lookup
    or registration observes and removes it. This property is not a strong-reference count or a liveness test.
    </remarks>
</member>

<member name="P:Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityAllocator.domainId">
    <summary>
    Gets the process-unique domain that qualifies every runtime identity allocated here.
    </summary>
</member>

<member name="E:Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityAllocator.ObjectUnregistered">
    <summary>
    Occurs after an object has been permanently removed from this allocator.
    </summary>
    <remarks>
    Every observer is invoked. Multiple observer failures are reported as one
    <see cref="T:System.AggregateException"/> after notification completes.
    </remarks>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityAllocator.EnterScope">
    <summary>
    Binds this allocator to the current asynchronous execution context until the returned scope is disposed.
    </summary>
    <returns>
    A strict last-in-first-out scope owned by the caller.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.InvalidOperationException">
    Thrown when scopes are disposed out of order.
    </exception>
</member>

symbols.documentation:
<member name="M:Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityAllocator.Register(Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityObject,System.Nullable{System.Guid})">
    <summary>
    Registers an object and assigns its session-local runtime identity.
    </summary>
    <param name="obj">
    The identity object owned by this runtime session.
    </param>
    <param name="persistentId">
    An optional persistent identity override. When omitted, the object's existing persistent identity is retained.
    An empty resolved identity is replaced with a newly generated identity.
    </param>
    <returns>
    <see langword="true"/> when the object was newly registered; otherwise, <see langword="false"/>.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentNullException">
    Thrown when <paramref name="obj"/> is null.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.InvalidOperationException">
    Thrown when a different live object is already registered with the resolved persistent identity.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityAllocator.InitializePersistentIdentity(Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityObject,System.Guid)">
    <summary>
    Assigns a persistent identity to a detached object without allocating a runtime identity.
    </summary>
    <param name="obj">
    The detached identity object to initialize.
    </param>
    <param name="persistentId">
    The non-empty persistent identity to assign.
    </param>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentNullException">
    Thrown when <paramref name="obj"/> is null.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    Thrown when <paramref name="persistentId"/> is empty.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.InvalidOperationException">
    Thrown when the object already has a live runtime identity.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityAllocator.Unregister(Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityObject)">
    <summary>
    Removes an object from this session and notifies every unregistration observer.
    </summary>
    <param name="obj">
    The identity object to remove.
    </param>
    <returns>
    <see langword="true"/> when the object was registered; otherwise, <see langword="false"/>.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentNullException">
    Thrown when <paramref name="obj"/> is null.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.AggregateException">
    Thrown after removal when one or more observers fail.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="T:Inno.Core.Identity.IdentityDomainId">
    <summary>
    Identifies one isolated runtime identity namespace within the current process.
    </summary>
    <remarks>
    Domain identifiers are runtime-only values. They must never be serialized or used as persistent object identity.
    </remarks>
</member>

    </param>
